name: google-cloud-developer
description: Google Cloud guidance for coding agents: first-project onboarding, authentication and credential selection, and safety-critical validation for gcloud CLI commands. Includes the Google Developer Knowledge MCP server for grounded, up-to-date Google Cloud documentation.
suggestedPrompts: Help me set up a new Google Cloud project, link billing, and configure local authentication.
Configure Application Default Credentials (ADC) and IAM permissions for my local development environment.
Search official Google Cloud documentation using Developer Knowledge and validate my gcloud CLI commands.
